about: Words of the assistant panel. The assistant's own replies come from the server.
title: Assistant
intro: Ask about a storm in the wiki, one of your forecasts, or what fits this card. It can also fill New forecast for you; nothing runs until you press Start.
placeholder: For example: what happened in the 2013 Oklahoma tornado?
not_set_up: The assistant runs on this computer's card. It needs a one-time download first.
download_note: Downloaded once, checked against its published digest, kept in
not_loaded: Off the card; it loads when you ask something
start_sends_form: Starts what is on the Create form now, with any changes you made.
name: Name for the forecast
where_endpoint: A model server (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp or another machine)
who_kev: Kev (open weights, on a server you run)
no_model_title: No model is set up on this computer
no_model_line: The assistant needs a language model to answer. There are two ways to get one:
no_model_download: Download {name} ({size}, {licence}) for this card. It is downloaded once and kept in {home}.
no_model_server: Or use a model server you already run, such as LM Studio or Ollama: open Settings below and give its address.
decision_unmeasured: this model server gives no probabilities
off_line: It is optional: the wiki, your forecasts and every other page work fully without it. Turned on, it answers questions about storms and your forecasts and can fill New forecast for you, using a language model on this computer or a model server you run.
off_card: For this card ({card} GB) it would use
off_no_card: With no card found it would use
off_asks: Turning it on downloads nothing and starts nothing. It then lists each file with its size and licence and asks before downloading, or you can point it at LM Studio, Ollama or another model server in its settings.
off_placeholder: The assistant is off. Turn it on above.
turned_off_unloaded: The assistant is off and its model left the card.
on_line: The assistant is on. Turn it off at any time; its model then leaves the card.
removed: Deleted the assistant's model and server ({size}).
download_title: The assistant needs these files. Nothing is downloaded until you press Download.
all_here: Everything it needs is already on this computer.
